description: On Our War With Iran 6/18/26 Citizens! Since September 2025, our government has been attacking suspected drug boats in international waters. The most recent one was this week, and to date, our attacks have killed 208 people. Some say they were nothing more than drug dealers smuggling in product. So what? One, they were delivering a product that there is plenty of demand for here in the US. [...]
title: America Has Lost Its Way – Gaylon Kent For Congress
